The race with `timeout(ms, ...)` is unchanged, so `TimeoutError` still comes from a slow `run()`. Results and rejection reasons pass through through `await`, with no wrapping. Aborting the caller's signal still just aborts the internal signal, which lifts the deadline and does not reject. The signature is unchanged. The change touches only `src/promise/withTimeout.ts` and its spec. I could not see `timeout.ts`, so I am assuming it clears its timer on abort without rejecting, as the existing semantics imply. The added tests check timer count and listener removal on all four outcomes.
